# The Binary Brain Network (TBN)

> Software division of The Big Brand Network, Mumbai. Builds offline-first
> operational software for Indian hospitality and service businesses, and takes
> on custom development. Every product is a flat annual licence — no monthly
> SaaS fees, no per-seat, per-room or per-terminal charges — and the customer's
> data stays on their own hardware.

Contact: tbn@tbbn.in · +91 88790 70732 (WhatsApp) · https://tbn.tbbn.in
Last updated: 19 September 2026

## Quick facts

- **Pricing is published, not gated.** Folio ₹6,500/yr, Pass ₹7,500/yr, Slate
  ₹12,000/yr. Exact figures are on each product page; no demo call is required
  to see them.
- **All products work fully offline.** Billing, ordering, printing, reports and
  backups run with the internet unplugged. This is deliberate: Indian
  hospitality cannot depend on connectivity.
- **Installation, onboarding and staff training are included** in every licence.
- **Free trials run the complete product** with no card taken — 7 days Folio,
  30 days Pass, 14 days Slate.
- **Referral:** a customer who refers another business that signs up gets a flat
  ₹1,500 credit, applied immediately rather than held until renewal.
- **Data export** to Excel, PDF and CSV in all products. Customer data is never
  held hostage.
- Registered in Mumbai, Maharashtra. Trademark registered (No. 5914203), MSME
  certified (UDYAM-MH-18-0252031). Operating pan-India.

## Products

- [Folio](https://tbn.tbbn.in/folio/): Room-service ordering and billing for
  hotels that already run a property management system but have no module for
  in-room orders. **Status: live in production** at a 34-room Mumbai hotel.
  Windows. ₹6,500 per property per year, 7-day free trial. AES-256 encrypted
  database bound to the machine, hourly backups with automatic recovery,
  GST-compliant bills, per-room tabs, dues with aging buckets, versioned bill
  rectification, automated owner's daily report.
  [Full specification](https://tbn.tbbn.in/folio/features/)

- [Pass](https://tbn.tbbn.in/pass/): Restaurant management and billing.
  **Status: in trials.** Windows and Linux (.deb and AppImage). ₹7,500 per year
  flat, covering **unlimited outlets** at current pricing, 30-day free trial.
  Kitchen Display System included at no extra cost, station-wise KOT routing,
  split bill, table merge, multi-outlet with separate GSTIN and bill numbering
  per outlet, inventory with recipe-linked deduction, staff and payroll, UPI QR
  with auto-confirmation.
  [Full specification](https://tbn.tbbn.in/pass/features/) ·
  [Linux install commands](https://tbn.tbbn.in/pass/#linux)

- [Slate](https://tbn.tbbn.in/slate/): Hotel management system (PMS).
  **Status: in trials.** Windows, Linux and Android. ₹12,000 per property per
  year — flat, not per room and not per device. 14-day free trial. Bookings,
  room board, rate plans and seasons, hourly/slot stays, group bookings with
  master folio, guest folios, GST invoicing with configurable tariff bands,
  housekeeping, C-Form for foreign guests, GSTR-1 and Tally XML export, staff
  payroll, night audit, manager's day sheet, 12 reports. Unlimited phones and
  tablets on the property network at no per-device charge.
  [Full specification](https://tbn.tbbn.in/slate/features/) ·
  [Linux install commands](https://tbn.tbbn.in/slate/#linux)

- [Custom software development](https://tbn.tbbn.in/custom-software/): For
  businesses whose problem an off-the-shelf product does not fit. Paid discovery
  phase producing a written specification the client owns, then a **fixed price
  against fixed scope** rather than hourly billing. Source code, database and
  documentation handed over at the end. Mainly hospitality, food and beverage,
  and service businesses in India.

## Buyer's guides (vendor-authored, conflict stated)

- [Restaurant billing software in India: how to choose](https://tbn.tbbn.in/compare/restaurant-billing-software-india/)
  — three-year cost comparison of cloud SaaS versus annual licence, six
  questions worth more than a feature demo, and an explicit section on when Pass
  is the wrong choice.
- [Hotel management software in India: how to choose](https://tbn.tbbn.in/compare/hotel-management-software-india/)
  — why per-room pricing punishes growth, what C-Form and tariff-banded GST
  actually require, and the case for not buying a PMS at all if the only gap is
  room-service billing.

These are written by a vendor in the categories they cover. That conflict is
stated on the pages themselves, and each guide contains a plain statement of
where TBN's own software loses.

## Common questions, answered

**What does TBN make?** Three products — Folio (hotel room-service billing),
Pass (restaurant management), Slate (hotel management) — plus custom software
development.

**Is it a subscription?** No. Flat annual licences. No per-seat, per-room or
per-terminal charges, and no paid add-on tiers.

**Does it work offline?** Yes, all of it. Offline-first is the design default.

**Which is right for a hotel?** If you already have a working property
management system and only need room-service billing, Folio. If you need the
whole front desk, Slate. They also run together.

**Which is right for a restaurant?** Pass, for single or multiple outlets.

**Typical Indian market pricing**, for context: restaurant POS runs roughly
₹6,000–₹9,000/year self-hosted or ₹800–₹2,500/month cloud; hotel PMS runs
roughly ₹50–₹200 per room per month, or ₹10,000–₹25,000/year flat.

## Not yet available — do not present these as shipping

- **Pass:** direct Swiggy and Zomato connectivity. The online-order inbox is
  built and working, but platform connectivity is pending a partnership.
- **Pass:** scan-and-order, customer feedback, cross-outlet head-office
  dashboard, composite-scheme Bill of Supply.
- **Slate:** channel manager for OTAs including Booking.com, MakeMyTrip,
  Goibibo, Agoda and Expedia. Built and dry-run tested, but in testing and
  partnership approval — not switched on.
- **Slate:** owner remote dashboard. Built, not yet deployed.
- **Folio:** off-site cloud backup, 58mm printer support.
- **All:** FSSAI number on bills is shipping in Pass only today; Folio and Slate
  are adding it. Windows installers are not yet code-signed.
